privacy.label: — LEGAL
privacy.title:
Privacy
notice.
privacy.intro: Grupo IHO and its subsidiaries in each country ("IHO") are responsible for the personal data you provide through this website.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: Name, company, email, phone and any information you include in messages, event registrations, quote or download requests.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: Responding to contact and quote requests, managing your event registration and access, sending the related confirmations and, only with your consent, sharing IHO news and events.

sections.title: Transfers
sections.body: Your data may be shared among Grupo IHO companies in Latin America and with providers of hosting, email and analytics services, who are bound to protect it. We never sell your data.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can access, correct or delete your data, object to its processing or withdraw your consent by writing to us through this website's contact form.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: Any change to this notice will be published on this page.
